name: api
description: This project was bootstrapped with Fastify-CLI.

scripts.test: npm run build:ts && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json && c8 node --test -r ts-node/register "test/**/*.ts"
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); if(fs.existsSync('dist')) for(const entry of fs.readdirSync('dist')) fs.rmSync(require('node:path').join('dist',entry), {recursive:true,force:true})"
scripts.start: npm run build:ts && fastify start -l info dist/app.js
scripts.test:db: node -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) { console.error('DATABASE_URL is required'); process.exit(1) }" && node --test -r ts-node/register test/storage.integration.ts test/availability-api.test.ts test/holidays.test.ts
